title: SunPath Solar Lease Warranty Coverage Table
content:
Each leased SunPath Solar Lease system is warranted as set out below, for the number of years shown for its size.

| Coverage | SunPath 3.2 kW | SunPath 4.0 kW | SunPath 4.8 kW | SunPath 5.6 kW | SunPath 6.4 kW | SunPath 8.0 kW |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Panel performance warranty | 25 years | 25 years | 25 years | 25 years | 25 years | 25 years |
| Inverter warranty | 12 years | 12 years | 25 years | 25 years | 25 years | 25 years |
| Installation workmanship warranty | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years |
| Roof penetration leak warranty | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years | 10 years |
| Storm damage repaired at the lessor's cost | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Panel performance warranty** — the panel performance warranty, in years.

**Inverter warranty** — the inverter warranty, in years. It is 12 years on the SunPath 3.2 kW and SunPath 4.0 kW systems and 25 years on the SunPath 4.8 kW system and every larger size.

**Installation workmanship warranty** — the installation workmanship warranty, in years.

**Roof penetration leak warranty** — the roof penetration leak warranty, in years.

**Storm damage** — whether storm damage to the system is repaired at the lessor's cost; it is for every size.

Comparing sizes: the only coverage that differs between sizes is the inverter warranty. A SunPath 4.0 kW system and a SunPath 4.8 kW system have the same panel, workmanship and roof penetration terms, while their inverter warranties are 12 and 25 years respectively.
